hints.title: Block Association
hints.text: Each black cell can be part of at most four 2x2 blocks represented by their top-left coordinates.

hints.title: Sparse Block Mapping
hints.text: Track the count of black cells for only those 2x2 blocks that contain at least one black cell.

hints.title: Zero Block Calculation
hints.text: Compute the count of blocks with zero black cells by subtracting the total non-zero blocks from (m - 1) times (n - 1).

hints.title: Sparse Coordinate Map Code

complexity.notes: Each black cell contributes to at most 4 block top-left coordinates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all (m-1)*(n-1) blocks takes up to 10^10 operations for large m and n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses sparse mapping around active cells and subtracts from total grid blocks.
